title: 30 Beats
description: The lives of a number of New Yorkers intertwine through a chain reaction of sexual encounters sparked by a summer heat wave.

title: Still Waiting ...
description: When a competing eatery steals their customers, restaurant employees hatch a raunchy plan to drum up business.

title: Mo' Money
description: After petty criminal Johnny (Damon Wayans) falls for the lovely Amber (Stacey Dash), he decides to stop breaking the law and gets a gig at his crush's workplace in order to get closer to her, thus proving that he's a stand-up guy. Soon, he learns that going straight doesn't pay very well, so he decides to nab a company credit card and show off his newfound wealth to Amber. Unfortunately, a blackmailer catches Johnny and forces him to commit a crime that is far from small.

title: Idlewild
description: A reticent piano player, named Percival (André Benjamin), along with Rooster (Antwan A. Patton), his flamboyant lead performer and manager, struggle to keep their speakeasy, in the Prohibition-era South, out of the hands of gangsters who want to take it over.

title: The Perfect Holiday
description: Nancy (Gabrielle Union), a divorced mother of three, feels especially lonely during the holidays. Sensing her sadness, Nancy's youngest daughter, Emily (Khail Bryant), has a plan to make her mom happy again. She asks Benjamin (Morris Chestnut), a department-store Santa Claus, to pay Nancy a compliment. And Benjamin, who is also a struggling songwriter, knows exactly the right words to say.

title: What Men Want
description: Passed up for a well-deserved promotion, sports agent Ali Davis wonders what else she needs to do to succeed in a man's world. Hoping to find answers from a psychic, Ali drinks a weird concoction that suddenly allows her to hear what men are thinking. Using her newfound ability, Ali starts to turn the tables on her obnoxious male colleagues while racing to sign the next basketball superstar.

title: Motives
description: A successful businessman (Shemar Moore) gets caught in a web of deceit after cheating on his wife (Vivica A. Fox).

title: Motives 2: Retribution
description: A man (Brian J. White) cuts through lies and deceit to investigate the murder of his imprisoned brother (Shemar Moore).

title: Hittin' It!
description: Two friends (Walker Howard, Maurice Patton) must repair a man's (Luther Campbell) house after a massive spring-break party leaves it in ruins.

title: Resurrection Road
description: A squad of six Black soldiers, led by ex-slave Barabbas, are sent on a suicide mission.

title: Apple Mortgage Cake
description: To avoid losing her home to foreclosure, single mother Angela Logan (Kimberly Elise) tries to bake and sell 100 apple cakes in 10 days.

title: Michael
description: The journey of pop star Michael Jackson, from his early days to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuels a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.
